states.claim: ctx->hdr_store is a heap buffer holding stored header bytes; data/start may be reassigned to point into ctx->hdr_store, making start a pointer into that storage region.
ctx->bs is a bitstream reader created over the start/remain region and reassigned to that region on subsequent iterations.
ctx->vparser is an MPEG-4 video parser created bound to ctx->bs.
ctx->src_pck is set to reference pck and its properties are referenced.
ctx->src_pck is released and set to NULL on EOS.
states.evidence:
L24: if (ctx->src_pck) gf_filter_pck_unref(ctx->src_pck);
L25: ctx->src_pck = NULL;

states.claim: ctx->hdr_store is reallocated to ctx->hdr_store_alloc and its size is tracked by ctx->hdr_store_size.
ctx->hdr_store_size is reset to 0 once packets are no longer reaggregated.
ctx->bytes_in_header bytes are stored in ctx->hdr_store for later start-code parsing.
On incomplete VOS/VOL parsing, data is copied into ctx->hdr_store and ctx->hdr_store_size is updated to retain the partial header.
ctx->resume_from records the offset into data or ctx->hdr_store from which parsing should resume.
pck is obtained from ctx->ipid and is dropped at function exit.
dst_pck is allocated on ctx->opid and dispatched via mpgviddmx_enqueue_or_dispatch.

values.claim: remain is initialized to pck_size and start is initialized to data, so remain bounds the bytes available at start.
When aggregating stored header data, hdr_store_alloc is set to hdr_store_size + pck_size and hdr_store is reallocated to that size before copying pck_size bytes at offset hdr_store_size.
After aggregation, hdr_store_size is increased by pck_size, and start/data/remain/pck_size are reset to the store base and total stored size.
When resuming from internally stored data, start/data point at hdr_store + resume_from and remain/pck_size equal hdr_store_size - resume_from.
When resuming without stored data, start is advanced by resume_from and remain is reduced by resume_from.
The bitstream is created or reassigned over the buffer start with length remain.

L104: gf_bs_reassign_buffer(ctx->bs, start, remain);

executions.claim: If remain < 5, the remaining bytes are copied into ctx->hdr_store, ctx->bytes_in_header is set to remain, and the loop breaks; thus no further parsing occurs with fewer than 5 bytes.

When ctx->resume_from is nonzero, execution continues only if the output pid would not block; if ctx->hdr_store_size is nonzero, start/data are set to ctx->hdr_store + ctx->resume_from and remain/pck_size to ctx->hdr_store_size - ctx->resume_from, with the assertion ctx->resume_from <= ctx->hdr_store_size; otherwise remain >= (s32) ctx->resume_from is asserted before advancing start and reducing remain.

When ctx->hdr_store_size is nonzero and not resuming, if ctx->hdr_store_alloc < ctx->hdr_store_size + pck_size then ctx->hdr_store_alloc is set to that sum and ctx->hdr_store is reallocated to that size before appending pck_size bytes.

When aggregating stored header data, if byte_offset is not GF_FILTER_NO_BO and byte_offset >= ctx->hdr_store_size, byte_offset is reduced by ctx->hdr_store_size; otherwise byte_offset becomes GF_FILTER_NO_BO.

If ctx->bytes_in_header is nonzero, 8 - ctx->bytes_in_header bytes are copied into ctx->hdr_store and current is set to the result of mpgviddmx_next_start_code(ctx->hdr_store, 8); if current < 0 or current >= (s32) ctx->bytes_in_header, the stored bytes are dispatched and ctx->bytes_in_header is reset to 0.

If a valid start code is found in the stored header, hdr_offset is set to 4 - ctx->bytes_in_header + current, bytes_from_store is set to ctx->bytes_in_header, ctx->bytes_in_header is reset to 0, and forced_sc_type is read from ctx->hdr_store[current+3] when hdr_offset is 0, otherwise from start[hdr_offset-1].

If current is -1, current is set to mpgviddmx_next_start_code(start, remain); if still negative and no frame has started, the loop breaks; otherwise the remaining bytes are dispatched and the loop breaks.

When no start code is found and a frame has started, size is set to remain; if any of the last three bytes is zero, copy_last_bytes is set true, size is reduced by 3, and ctx->bytes_in_header is set to 3.
If vosh_start >= 0 and current is nonzero, remain >= current is asserted, start is advanced by current, remain is reduced by current, and current is set to 0.
If ctx->opid is null and current is nonzero, remain >= current is asserted, start is advanced by current, remain is reduced by current, and current is set to 0.

When current > 0 and bytes_from_store is nonzero, bytes_from_store >= (u32) current is asserted, bytes_from_store is reduced by current, and current bytes are copied from ctx->hdr_store; otherwise remain >= current is asserted, start is advanced by current, remain is reduced by current, and current is set to 0.
After dispatching remaining bytes, if remain < 5, the remaining bytes are copied into ctx->hdr_store, ctx->bytes_in_header is set to remain, and the loop breaks.

If sc_type_forced is true, the bitstream buffer is reassigned to start + hdr_offset with length remain - hdr_offset and sc_type is set to forced_sc_type; otherwise the buffer is reassigned to start with length remain and sc_type is read after skipping 24 bits.

In the M2V_SEQ_START_CODE/M2V_EXT_START_CODE case, if gf_m4v_parse_config returns GF_EOS, vosh_start is set to 0 if negative; if data equals ctx->hdr_store, the remaining bytes are moved to ctx->hdr_store and ctx->hdr_store_size is set to remain; otherwise, if ctx->hdr_store_alloc < ctx->hdr_store_size + pck_size - vosh_start, it is grown and ctx->hdr_store reallocated, then pck_size - vosh_start bytes from data + vosh_start are appended and ctx->hdr_store_size is increased by pck_size - vosh_start; the input packet is dropped and GF_OK is returned.

In the M4V_VOL_START_CODE case, if gf_m4v_parse_config returns GF_EOS, vosh_start is set to 0 if negative; if data equals ctx->hdr_store, the remaining bytes are moved to ctx->hdr_store and ctx->hdr_store_size is set to remain; otherwise, if ctx->hdr_store_alloc < ctx->hdr_store_size + pck_size - vosh_start, it is grown and ctx->hdr_store reallocated, then pck_size - vosh_start bytes from data + vosh_start are appended and ctx->hdr_store_size is increased by pck_size - vosh_start; the input packet is dropped and GF_OK is returned.

In the M4V_VOL_START_CODE case when parsing succeeds, obj_size is obtained from gf_m4v_get_object_start; vosh_start is set to 0 if negative; vosh_end is computed as start - data + obj_size - vosh_start; remain >= (s32) obj_size is asserted; start is advanced by obj_size and remain reduced by obj_size.
In the M4V_VO_START_CODE/M4V_VISOBJ_START_CODE/default case, if vosh_start >= 0, remain >= 4 is asserted, start is advanced by 4, and remain is reduced by 4.
If ctx->opid is null, remain >= 4 is asserted, start is advanced by 4, remain is reduced by 4, and the loop continues.
If ctx->is_playing is false, ctx->resume_from is set to (u32)((char *)start - (char *)data) and GF_OK is returned.
If remain < 5 after the seek check, the loop continues without parsing a frame.

executions.claim: If gf_m4v_parse_frame returns GF_EOS and ctx->input_is_au_end is false, the last three bytes of start are examined; if any is zero, copy_last_bytes is set true, size >= 3 is asserted, size is reduced by 3, and ctx->bytes_in_header is set to 3; full_frame is set false.

If is_coded is false, ctx->forced_packed and ctx->b_frames are both true, ctx->is_packed is set true, remain >= size is asserted, start is advanced by size, remain is reduced by (s32) size, and the loop continues.

If is_coded is false and ctx->vfr is true, ctx->is_vfr is set true, mpgviddmx_update_time is called, remain >= size is asserted, start is advanced by size, remain is reduced by (s32) size, and the loop continues.

When bytes_from_store is nonzero, bytes_from_store bytes are copied from ctx->hdr_store + current, size >= bytes_from_store is asserted, size is reduced by bytes_from_store, and the remaining size bytes are copied from start; otherwise size bytes are copied from start.
After copying frame data, pck_data[0] == 0, pck_data[1] == 0, and pck_data[2] == 0x01 are asserted.

If full_frame is false, when copy_last_bytes is true the last three bytes of start are copied into ctx->hdr_store, and the loop breaks; otherwise remain >= size is asserted, start is advanced by size, and remain is reduced by (s32) size.
